briefdescription.para: NMT-01: TRANSPORT_CLOSED is connection-closing on every transport path.
NMT-02: TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE is connection-closing — no silent drop.
NMT-03: TRANSPORT_FALLBACK_ACTIVE is NOT connection-closing — fallback is in progress, the connection is still live.
NMT-04: TRANSPORT_WRITE_ERROR is not connection-closing — write errors are retryable at the protocol layer.
NMT-05: Frame validation on WebSocket path — invalid magic bytes yield FRAME_INVALID (fail-closed, connection-closing).
NMT-06: Backpressure exceeded on UDP path → BACKPRESSURE_EXCEEDED, which is transient (retryable), not connection-closing.
NMT-07: Concurrent connection count exceeds kMaxConcurrentConnections → CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (bounded admission control, not a crash).
NMT-08: Fallback sequence exhaustion — primary CLOSED, fallback UNAVAILABLE → final error is TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed).

detaileddescription.para: Contract: no silent data loss; caller must receive an explicit error.

briefdescription.para: NAG-01: Burst of AUTH_REQUIRED events — every unauthenticated request is rejected; no leak of data to unauthenticated callers.
NAG-02: Rate-limit enforcement under burst traffic — requests beyond the per-connection window are rejected with RATE_LIMITED.
NAG-03: CLIENT_BANNED after sustained rate-limit threshold violations.

detaileddescription.para: After kRateLimitBanThreshold consecutive violations, new requests must receive CLIENT_BANNED rather than RATE_LIMITED.

briefdescription.para: NAG-04: Stalled authentication handshake → AUTH_TIMEOUT, which is connection-closing (prevents resource exhaustion from hung sessions).
NAG-05: SESSION_REVOKED takes priority over SESSION_EXPIRED.

detaileddescription.para: A revoked session must always be rejected with SESSION_REVOKED regardless of whether it is also expired, preventing expiry-bypass attacks.

briefdescription.para: NAG-06: Rate-limiter unavailability → fail-closed deny (not fail-open).

detaileddescription.para: When the rate-limiting backend is unreachable, no request must be let through — fail-open would allow adversarial traffic to bypass limits.

briefdescription.para: NAG-07: BACKPRESSURE_EXCEEDED is transient, NOT connection-closing.

detaileddescription.para: Backpressure is a temporary condition; the connection must remain alive so that the client can retry after the queue drains.

briefdescription.para: NAG-08: Cluster-level errors (QUORUM_DEGRADED, ROUTING_UNAVAILABLE) are not connection-closing — they reflect cluster state, not a transport failure that terminates the client connection.
Phase 2 network module hardening focused tests — multi-transport failure injection and adversarial auth/rate-limit guard hardening.

detaileddescription.para: Covers the two Q3 2026 open items from src/network/ROADMAP.md Phase 2:

(a) Complete remaining failure-injection coverage for multi-transport edge cases (TCP, WebSocket, UDP, QUIC paths). (b) Tighten auth/rate-limit/session guard behavior under sustained adversarial traffic.
All tests are deterministic and self-contained — no live sockets or real network I/O are used.

sect2.title: Test Cases
sect2.para: NMT-01 TRANSPORT_CLOSED is a connection-closing error on every path. NMT-02 TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE is a connection-closing error. NMT-03 TRANSPORT_FALLBACK_ACTIVE is NOT connection-closing (in-progress). NMT-04 TRANSPORT_WRITE_ERROR is NOT connection-closing (retryable). NMT-05 Frame validation on WS path — invalid magic → FRAME_INVALID. NMT-06 Backpressure exceeded on UDP path → transient error (retryable). NMT-07 Connection limit reached → CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (bounded). NMT-08 Fallback sequence: primary UNAVAILABLE → fallback exhausted → TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed, no silent data loss).

NAG-01 Burst of AUTH_REQUIRED events — every request rejected, no leak. NAG-02 Rate-limit enforcement under burst (100 rapid-fire requests). NAG-03 CLIENT_BANNED after sustained rate-limit threshold violations. NAG-04 AUTH_TIMEOUT for stalled handshake → connection-closing. NAG-05 Revocation beats expiry: SESSION_REVOKED not SESSION_EXPIRED. NAG-06 Rate-limiter unavailability → fail-closed deny (not fail-open). NAG-07 BACKPRESSURE_EXCEEDED is transient, not connection-closing. NAG-08 QUORUM_DEGRADED and ROUTING_UNAVAILABLE are not connection-closing (cluster-level errors do not terminate the transport connection).
